# The Grounds by Aldar

> Dubai’s first vitality community in Dubai Silicon Oasis. Independent launch site for 3 and 4 bedroom townhouses and villas by Aldar and Dubai Holding. Guide price from AED 2.85M; sales launch expected December 2026.

Prices, areas and payment schedules are indicative until Aldar publishes official sales documents. Register interest via the popup form on any page; it does not reserve a home.

## Pages

- [The Grounds by Aldar](https://thegrounds.ae/): Overview of the vitality community in Dubai Silicon Oasis, home types, amenities and launch timeline.
- [Townhouses](https://thegrounds.ae/townhouses/): 3 and 4 bedroom townhouses, about 2,040 and 2,200 sq. ft., from AED 2.85M.
- [Villas](https://thegrounds.ae/villas/): 4 bedroom twin villas from AED 3.95M and 3 and 4 bedroom standalone villas from AED 4.1M.
- [Location](https://thegrounds.ae/location/): Where The Grounds is in Dubai Silicon Oasis, roads, Academic City and the 2029 Blue Line station.
- [Price list](https://thegrounds.ae/price-list/): Guide starting prices for all five home types and price per sq. ft. at entry.
- [Payment plan](https://thegrounds.ae/payment-plan/): The quoted 5/45/50 plan with worked amounts per home, DLD and Oqood fees, escrow.
- [Brochure](https://thegrounds.ae/brochure/): Register for The Grounds brochure PDF, sent when Aldar releases it at launch.
- [Floor plans](https://thegrounds.ae/floor-plans/): Register for townhouse and villa floor plans, sent as PDFs at launch.

## Crawling & discovery

- [Sitemap index](https://thegrounds.ae/sitemap-index.xml): Entry point listing page and image sitemaps.
- [Page sitemap](https://thegrounds.ae/sitemap.xml): HTML URLs for the site.
- [Image sitemap](https://thegrounds.ae/sitemap-images.xml): Images with titles and captions per page.
- [Image map JSON](https://thegrounds.ae/images-map.json): Machine-readable media catalog (URLs, alt text, page associations).
- [LLM full guide](https://thegrounds.ae/llms-full.txt): Extended notes, media list and IndexNow details.
